name: gnu-as-x86-64
description: Syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, diagnostics, formatting, navigation and build tools for GNU as (GAS) x86-64 assembly.

gas.assembler.path.description: Path to the GNU assembler executable.

gas.assembler.args.description: Extra arguments passed to `as` (for diagnostics and builds). Example: ["--64", "-g", "--defsym", "DEBUG=1"].

gas.preprocessor.path.description: Compiler driver used for files with an upper-case `.S` extension, which need the C preprocessor (`gcc -x assembler-with-cpp`).

gas.preprocessor.args.description: Extra arguments passed to the preprocessor driver for `.S` files (for example -D defines).

gas.linker.path.description: Linker executable used by 'Assemble and Link'. Set to `gcc` to link against libc (e.g. programs that define `main`).

gas.linker.args.description: Extra arguments passed to the linker. Example with ld: ["-lc", "--dynamic-linker=/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2"]. Example with gcc: ["-no-pie"].

gas.objdump.path.description: Path to objdump, used by 'Show Disassembly'.

gas.objdump.args.description: Arguments passed to objdump before the object file.

gas.build.outputDirectory.description: Where object files and executables are written. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${fileDirname} and ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.

gas.includePaths.description: Extra include directories (passed as -I) and used to resolve .include / #include links.

gas.lint.enable.description: Enable built-in static checks (unbalanced blocks, duplicate labels, undefined local labels, operand-size problems, AT&T syntax slips).

enumDescriptions: Never run the assembler for diagnostics.
Run `as` when a file is opened or saved and show its errors inline.
Run `as` while typing (debounced). Uses the unsaved buffer.
gas.lint.assembler.description: Run the real assembler to produce authoritative diagnostics.

gas.lint.unknownDirectives.description: Warn about directives that are not in the extension's directive list.

gas.lint.unknownInstructions.description: Warn about mnemonics that are not in the extension's instruction database (the database does not cover every AVX-512 variant, so this is off by default).

gas.lint.undefinedSymbols.description: Report symbols that are used but defined nowhere in the workspace (they will have to come from another object file or library).

gas.format.useTabs.description: Indent instructions with a tab instead of spaces.

gas.format.indentSize.description: Instruction indentation in columns (also the tab width used for alignment).

gas.format.mnemonicWidth.description: Pad mnemonics/directives to this width so operands line up.

gas.format.commentColumn.description: Column at which trailing comments are aligned. 0 keeps a single space before the comment.

gas.format.indentDirectives.description: Indent directives such as .globl and .quad like instructions.

gas.format.mnemonicCase.description: Case conversion applied to known instruction mnemonics.

gas.outline.showLocalLabels.description: Show `.L` labels and numeric labels in the outline and breadcrumbs.

gas.hover.showSyscalls.description: Show Linux syscall names when hovering `syscall` and the number loaded into %rax.

gas.workspace.include.description: Glob of files indexed for cross-file go-to-definition, references, rename and workspace symbols.

gas.workspace.exclude.description: Glob of files excluded from the workspace index.

gas.workspace.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to index.
